content.caption: A long grey mound fills the middle of the frame, with a dark tree trunk and its heavy green canopy looming in the foreground. Pines and a leafy tree stand behind it, and a strip of blue water shows on the horizon at the right.
content.opinion: The mound is not the telescope I was aiming at, but the picture is still mine, and I will allow it to count as proof of my claim.
